answer: One enforceable rule: require consistent long-form persona presence across two disconnected communities. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The relic of work and the shale of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a comet to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
